headline: Lead DevOps / SRE Engineer | GitLab CI/CD | Kubernetes
page_title: Rajendra P N - DevOps SRE GitLab Kubernetes Engineer
summary_html: Lead DevOps / SRE Engineer with 10+ years of experience in cloud infrastructure, delivery automation, and production reliability. Engineers Kubernetes platforms, Helm deployments, GitLab CI/CD, and Terraform/Ansible automation across Azure and AWS. Develops Python and shell tooling, administers Linux systems, and troubleshoots networking and container workloads. Uses Prometheus, Grafana, and New Relic to improve service visibility and incident response; applies Argo CD GitOps and supports AI/ML service infrastructure and operational readiness.
